findings.finding: The proposed change for field0 deviates from the exact wording of the official message shown in the code: 'Some saved information could not be opened. It is still on this device. You can try opening the related page again or remove the saved information here.' The rewrite adds explanations about potential storage issues and possible consequences ('to avoid confusion from outdated data', 'to help clear storage issues', etc.) that are not present or supported in the source. Preserving the official user-facing notice is required by policy, and explanations or added reasoning not present in the source should not be introduced into these notification fields.

The revised field1 text expands the original message with explanations and extra context ('may be necessary if you want to reset your saved work, address storage problems, or prepare this browser for shared use') that are not present in the source. The notification in code only says: 'Deleting all private information also removes your practice plans, practice reflection, and saved resources from this browser.
